To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a hypothesis space V has suitable instances for all denotational and operational control structures if and only if V is learnable.
learnability invariance over V is equivalent to V having suitable instances of all the denotational control structure characterizations presented herein.

the presence of control structures in a hypothesis space is a necessary condition for the learnability of that space, that the absence of control structures in the space is a necessary and sufficient condition for the learnablility of the space, and that the learnability of a hypothesis space is invariant over the space if and only if the space is a control structure space.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of control structure on learnability.
the following question: How does the presence of control structures affect the learnability of a concept space?
the following question: what are the effects on learning of the presence or absent of control structures in a hypothesis space?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the control structures are the essential elements in a hypothesis space that determine its learning properties.
the control structures of a learning class are the denotational control structure instances present in the hypothesis space of the learning class.
, for a hypothesis space V, the presence or absence in V of any of a certain class of control structures has a significant influence on the learnability of V.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for any learnability result, if the hypothesis space is rich enough in control structures, then the result holds.
, if a learning class is invariant over some hypothesis space V then V is rich enough to have suitable instances of all control structures.
the presence of control structures in a hypothesis space can be used as an aid to learning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, when learning, control structures are important.
the presence or absence in a hypothesis space of suitable instances of certain control structures has a strong effect on the learnability of the class of concepts definable therein.
, in a given learnability setting, the presence of certain control structures is a necessary and sufficient condition for the invariance over hypothesis space of certain learning classes.
